# Emily

## Overview

- **Role:** dressmaker  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P1](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0001)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

_Not yet known._

## Personality

Emily possesses exceptional taste in dressmaking. She is also renowned for her ability to create garments with unmatched fit.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P1](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0001)_

_Not yet known._

## History

During her time at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), Emily belonged to a close group of ambitious friends alongside [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), who maintained a friendly academic rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). As spring examinations approached, Emily and her classmates anxiously prepared for their tests and discussed their commencement attire while listening to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) share her philosophical mindset.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P7](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P8](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P11](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0011)_
